environment.baseline_scope: trusted local disk same Tahoe n4/k2 codec reads, no HTTP/signature/quorum; not an equivalent security system
environment.cache: warm server data and OS cache; fresh CLI per request

storage_scope: Aggregate snapshots include prior sample/repair files; each snapshot precedes that size repair sweep. Not final campaign footprint or per-file-only amplification.

stability.policy: closed-loop one outstanding CLI; saturation sweep above uses scheduled arrivals

limits: Fresh CLI startup/imports, disk/fsync, security and network are in the measured path
Scheduled worker queue delay is included; finite completion is not sustainable offered-rate capacity
Same-codec trusted disk baseline omits authenticated HTTP/quorum and is only an overhead floor
Load faults stop servers; actively malicious servers were not exercised under load
Two stopped servers must reject metadata quorum; all rejections were exit2/specific error/no output per measured oracle
Repair/restart timings lack a matched trusted/no-fault repair-time baseline
Only the separate 4 KiB client was profiled; cannot diagnose the 1 MiB limiter
Stability is 4 KiB closed-loop only; no WAN/Tahoe-grid/formal-Byzantine claim
